modules.title: 产品发现在写代码前验证假设的闭环
一个产品想法怎样变成可验证的决定

items.title: 失败前：把团队猜测当成用户需求
items.text: 团队想到“创作者需要对比提示词结果”，就直接让 AI 开始做账号、工作台和设置页。功能按计划交付，只能证明团队完成了开发，不能证明目标用户确实遇到这个问题，也不能证明现有方案值得替换。

items.title: 把高风险判断写成假设，再收集行为证据
items.text: 分别写清价值、可用性、可行性和业务约束。例如“创作者会手工并排比较结果，而且经常因此返工”。访谈时追问最近一次真实操作和临时办法，再用纸面或低保真原型观察选择任务。假设必须对应可观察行为，口头称赞不能单独作为立项依据。

items.title: 结果是改变决定，不是凑齐一份报告
items.text: 如果证据只支持“需要快速看差异”，就把方案收窄为两列对比，而不是继续扩展完整工作台；如果没人遇到这个问题，就暂停并重新判断。继续、收窄、转向或停止，只要理由和证据能对应，都是有效产出。

modules.title: 产品发现不是无休止的研讨
modules.text: 产品发现不是一次会议，也没有固定访谈人数或万能方法。少量证据只能降低当前假设的不确定性，不能证明市场一定存在；新的用户反馈、技术限制和业务目标还会让团队重新判断。

lessonPractice.title: 访谈和低保真测试发现：用户确实会手工并排比较结果，但目前只在意快速看差异，没人使用团队协作或多种导出。下一步怎样做更符合产品发现？

options.label: 把范围收窄到双栏差异和保存结果，继续观察目标用户是否能完成任务并重复使用
options.feedback: 对。现有证据支持的是更小的问题范围；下一步应据此缩小方案并继续验证，而不是自动批准全部功能。

options.label: 既然有人需要比较，就把团队协作、多种导出、支付和管理后台一起完成
options.feedback: 不对。证据只支持快速比较，不能顺带证明其他功能有价值；扩大范围会重新引入未经验证的假设。

options.label: 因为用户没有认可完整方案，立刻认定比较需求不存在，并停止记录这次发现
options.feedback: 不对。用户已经展示了真实的手工比较行为。合理决定是收窄问题并继续验证，而不是忽略已有证据。

en.title: Research shows users manually compare results side by side, but they currently care only about spotting differences; nobody uses collaboration or multiple exports. What should happen next?

options.label: Narrow the scope to two-column differences and saved results, then keep observing task completion and repeat use
options.feedback: Correct. The evidence supports a smaller problem scope, so the next test should narrow the solution rather than approve every proposed feature.

options.label: Because comparison matters, finish collaboration, multiple exports, payments, and an admin dashboard together
options.feedback: Incorrect. Evidence for quick comparison does not validate the other features; expanding the scope adds untested assumptions.

options.label: Because users did not endorse the full concept, conclude that no comparison problem exists and discard the research
options.feedback: Incorrect. Users demonstrated real manual comparison behavior. Narrowing and testing again fits the evidence better.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 我想为独立创作者做一个提示词结果对比工具。先不要写完整代码或高保真 UI：请列出最危险的价值、可用性、可行性和业务假设，先问我已有证据，再设计一轮基于最近真实经历的访谈和低保真任务测试。每项测试都写清要观察的行为、支持或推翻假设的信号，以及证据不足时是继续、缩小范围还是暂停。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: I want to build a prompt-result comparison tool for independent creators. Do not build the full product or high-fidelity UI yet. List the riskiest value, usability, feasibility, and business assumptions; ask what evidence already exists; then design interviews around recent real events and one low-fidelity task. Define observable signals and whether each outcome means continue, narrow, or pause.

learning.assumes: You have product feature ideas but tend to treat personal intuition as universal user demand.
learning.outcome: You can turn an idea into testable assumptions, choose low-cost behavioral evidence, and decide whether to continue, narrow, redirect, or stop.

modules.title: How product discovery validates hypotheses before writing code
How a product idea becomes a testable decision

items.title: Before: the team treats a guess as user demand
items.text: The team assumes creators need prompt-result comparison and immediately asks AI to build accounts, dashboards, and settings. Shipping those features proves delivery, not that target users face the problem or would replace their current workaround.

items.title: Write risky assumptions, then gather behavioral evidence
items.text: Separate value, usability, feasibility, and business constraints. For example: creators manually compare results and this repeatedly causes rework. Reconstruct the last real event and workaround, then observe one selection task with a paper or low-fidelity prototype. Each assumption needs observable behavior; compliments alone are insufficient.

items.title: The outcome is a changed decision
items.text: If evidence supports only quick visual comparison, narrow the concept to a two-column view instead of expanding a full workspace. If the problem does not appear, pause and reassess. Continue, narrow, redirect, or stop are all valid outcomes when the evidence explains the choice.

modules.title: Discovery is not endless meetings
modules.text: Product discovery is not a meeting and has no universal sample size or method. Limited evidence only reduces uncertainty around the current assumption; new user, technical, or business evidence can reopen the decision.

distinctions.label: PRD
distinctions.text: {c:product-discovery} reduces uncertainty about the problem and solution with evidence; a {c:prd} records the current scope, rules, and acceptance requirements. Discovery evidence can still change or stop that plan.

distinctions.label: MVP
distinctions.text: {c:product-discovery} is the ongoing process of collecting evidence and changing decisions; an {c:mvp} is the smallest usable approach for testing a key assumption and may be limited to a small test group. An MVP can be one discovery experiment.
